input.prompt:
A raw, grainy 35mm film photograph, capturing an intense, unfiltered moment under the harsh glare of a direct flash. The extreme overexposure from the flash creates stark, blown-out highlights and deep, crushing shadows, stripping away any sense of depth and immersing the scene in a visceral, almost oppressive atmosphere. The image feels stolen—documentary in nature, as if revealing something that was never meant to be seen.

At the center, a close-up of an animal’s thick, coarse fur, its texture violently illuminated by the flash, causing an almost ethereal glow against the void-like darkness of the background. The contrast is brutal—bright, blinding whites of the fur against the cold, reflective surface of a heavy, industrial metal collar strapped tightly around its neck. The metallic surface of the collar flares under the intense light, revealing deep scratches, dents, and signs of oxidation, making it feel aged, functional, and almost ritualistic.  the image is fractured by layered motion blur, a stroboscopic effect distorting the body into overlapping gestures, as if caught in a looped ritual. The flickering traces of movement create an eerie sense of repetition, like a sequence of sacred motions being performed again and again.

Jagged, irregular metal spikes protrude aggressively from the collar, their harsh edges catching the flash and scattering fragmented reflections. The spikes appear carelessly welded, twisted, and brutalist in design, reinforcing the object’s utilitarian, almost cruel purpose. Rusted wire coils around sections of the collar, some strands unraveling chaotically, adding to the sense of raw, industrial brutality.

The ground is damp, textured with patches of wild grass and disturbed soil, barely visible in the darkness beyond the flash’s reach. The trees and distant structures dissolve into the void, making the setting feel isolated, liminal, and ominous. The colors are desaturated, washed in deep blues, pale greens, and the stark white of the flash, enhancing the industrial, brutalist aesthetic of the scene.

The motion blur, harsh light, and deep shadows make the image feel alive, as if capturing a moment in an unknown ritual, a mechanical invocation, or an experimental ceremony where faith and technology collide.

The image is relentless in its stark, high-contrast brutality, where the harsh flash transforms an ordinary subject into something alien, uncomfortably intimate, and strikingly raw. use tokpotere

extra_lora.title: Extra Lora
extra_lora.description: Load LoRA weights. Supports Replicate models in the format <owner>/<username> or <owner>/<username>/<version>, HuggingFace URLs in the format huggingface.co/<owner>/<model-name>, CivitAI URLs in the format civitai.com/models/<id>[/<model-name>], or arbitrary .safetensors URLs from the Internet. lora_scale.title: Lora Scale
lora_scale.description: Determines how strongly the main LoRA should be applied. Sane results between 0 and 1 for base inference. You may still need to experiment to find the best value for your particular lora.

guidance_scale.title: Guidance Scale
